settings.label: Require Approval for New Lines
settings.affects: New lines start as needing approval; lines must be approved before work/parts proceed (WO-1 status path).

settings.label: Require Review Before Completion
settings.affects: Whether a Review/sign-off step sits between the work and completion/invoice (WO-1).

settings.label: Require Tech Story
settings.affects: Whether a line can be completed without a tech story.

settings.label: Require Mileage
settings.affects: Whether a line can be completed without mileage.

settings.label: Require Engine Hours
settings.affects: Whether a line can be completed without engine hours.

settings.label: Require Ordering Parts
settings.affects: Parts must be clicked Order before they count as ordered (part line path on WO-1..4).

settings.label: Require Receiving Parts Before Completion
settings.affects: Every part must be received before the WO can be completed, reviewed or invoiced (blocks Create Invoice until received).

settings.label: Require Picking Inventory Parts
settings.affects: Inventory parts must be clicked Pick before they are ready (inventory part path).
